'''Roon Tac''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who was an admirer of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
